Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; reviewed period printings; issue #737.

Cards.Name: Magistrate's Stipend
Cards.Text:
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if paying for a Magistrate which may only pay for that card.
Reaction: After you announce a non-Iaijutsu action, choose your performing Magistrate to give him +1C until the action ends.
